Run DRT-01 then DRT-02; hold at #142; after terminal production evidence run DRT-03, then DRT-04, then DRT-05 and DRT-06 in parallel, and release DRT-07 only after both are terminal.

Recompute exact revisions, card/index digests, topology manifests, producer receipts, fault outcomes, lease/quorum transitions, replay digests, and per-phase resource cleanup; halt immediately on stale authority or leaked resources.

invariants: The umbrella may coordinate and synthesize but cannot modify child-owned product paths.
Children retain exclusive implementation and review ownership.
No unsupported completion, legal, production, or release claim

risks: Umbrella scope could absorb child work
